I replied to Marcus in a thread on their #north-team message: the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is on 25 November.

That date comes from Ilse's 14 October post in #north-team. Marcus is a member of that channel, so they can see that post themselves. I couldn't double-check the date because there are no Brackenwater files under `accounts/brackenwater` in the share, and I told Marcus that.
